data.name: Balkar
data.gender_notes: Balkar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is strong and powerful, derived from the Sanskrit word 'bal' meaning strength and 'kar' meaning doer. The name Balkar carries the meaning “God of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Punjabi. Parents who choose Balkar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage required to overcome life's challenges, and the power to rule and protect.
data.etymology: Balkar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balkar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
